mapper.sql: id, bucket, object_key, original_name, content_type, size, sha256, scan_status, owner_type, owner_id, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, retention_until
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_object (bucket, object_key, original_name, content_type, size, sha256, scan_status, owner_type, owner_id, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, retention_until, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{bucket}, #{objectKey}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{size}, #{sha256}, #{scanStatus}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{uploadedBy}, NOW(3), #{retentionUntil}, #{uploadedBy}, #{uploadedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM file_object WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM file_object WHERE owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM file_object WHERE deleted = 0 AND retention_until IS NOT NULL AND retention_until < #{today} LIMIT 1000
mapper.update: UPDATE file_object SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
